newsitem.title: CHINA: National Dev Bank of Sri Lanka signs $50 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: National Dev Bank of Sri Lanka signs $50 mln loan.

text.p: National Development Bank of Sri Lanka signed a 10-year US$50 million equivalent syndicated loan on Friday in Singapore, the arrangers said.
The loan consists of two tranches -- a 2.311 billion yen tranche led by Nippon Life Insurance Co and a US$30 million tranche led by Industrial Bank of Japan.
The loan came with a guarantee of principal repayment from the Asian Development Bank (ADB) and an interest payment guarantee from the Sri Lankan government.
Loan proceeds will be on-lent to export-driven projects in line with a proposed ADB assisted Small and Medium Enterprise Assistance Project.
Nippon Life Insurance Co, Industrial Bank of Japan and Dresdner (South East Asia) are the lead managers.
Bank of Nova Scotia Asia, Bayerische Landesbank's Singapore branch and Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank's Singapore branch are the senior managers.
